name: coffeepos
description: Lệnh kiểm thử gom cho cả repo — chi tiết trong TEST_CHECKLIST.md

scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix backend && npm run lint --prefix frontend
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix backend && npm run typecheck --prefix frontend
scripts.static: npm run lint && npm run typecheck
scripts.audit: npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high --prefix backend && npm audit --omit=dev --audit-level=high --prefix frontend
scripts.test:unit: npm run test:cov --prefix backend && npm run test:ci --prefix frontend
scripts.test:all: npm run static && npm run audit && npm run test:unit && npm run test:api && npm run stack:e2e:up && npm run test:smoke && npm run test:e2e && npm run test:perf && npm run coverage:summary
